info.description: Run top to bottom. OTPs: phone OTP from the API log (sms.sent), email OTP from Mailpit http://localhost:8025. Partners are mocked: Digio via WireMock (8080), TrackWizz via the local mock (8099).

item.name: 06A-06B · Portfolio import (MF Central)
item.description:
Screens 06A-06B through OUR backend. Two ways to run it:

REAL MF CENTRAL UAT (backend started with .env pointing at uatservices.mfcentral.com): before folder 01 set collection variable `pan` to one of MF Central's UAT test PANs (AQQPS7576R, AATPJ9485B, ANKPJ4391C, AAQPH6449C, AOBPC3943B, AAAPS6436J, DZMPA3911G, BVPPB8007F; use a new phone per run) and run 01 → 06. Then: '06A Start' → copy `authorisation_url` from the console/variable and open it in a browser → OTP = 00 + last four PAN digits (e.g. 007576) → keep 'Summary of Holdings' → download the QR image → '06A Upload the QR image (file)' with that PNG → '06A Import status' / '06B Assets dashboard'. MF Central's page then redirects the browser to MFCENTRAL_REDIRECT_URL (not needed for the upload).

LOCAL STUB (docker stack / .env pointing at WireMock): there is no MF Central page; run 'Simulate MF Central return' and 'Upload the QR image (base64)' (the preset qr_code_base64 is a real UAT sample; anything ≥ 100 chars works, one starting with the base64 of 'BADQR' is rejected).

request.description: 201 {import_id, status: AWAITING_AUTHORISATION, authorisation_url (MF Central's /api/auth/start?data=… hand-off), expires_at, next_screen}. Calling again while the import is open returns the same import (one vendor request). PAN digits 9999 → FAILED provider_rejected (unwhitelisted PAN on UAT).

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('import_id', b.import_id); if (b.authorisation_url) pm.collectionVariables.set('authorisation_url', b.authorisation_url); console.log('import', b.status, b.authorisation_url || '(no authorisation_url: status ' + b.status + ')');

item.name: 06A MF Central page (real UAT: open authorisation_url in a browser)

request.description: Encrypted hand-off to MF Central: OTP (UAT: 00 + last four PAN digits), Summary/Detailed, QR download, then MF Central sends the browser to MFCENTRAL_REDIRECT_URL?status=success&reqId=… (our callback) which 302s to MFCENTRAL_RETURN_URL?import_id=…&status=awaiting_qr. Not available on the local WireMock stack.

What MF Central's page does from the investor's browser; no session. Locally the stub issues reqId = import_id. 302 to MFCENTRAL_RETURN_URL?import_id=…&status=awaiting_qr (unknown reqId → status=unknown; status=error&code=…&message=… → DECLINED).

exec: pm.test('302 to the FE', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(302); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Location')).to.include('import_id=' + pm.collectionVariables.get('import_id')); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Location')).to.include('status=awaiting_qr'); });

request.description: multipart/form-data with the PNG downloaded from MF Central's page as field `qr_image` (≤ 2 MB). Same response as the base64 variant: 200 {import_id, status: IMPORTED, next_screen: ASSETS_DASHBOARD}; 422 with MF Central's message if they reject the image (import stays open, see last_error on the status call).

formdata.description: select the QR PNG you downloaded from MF Central

item.name: 06A Upload the QR image (base64, local stub)

request.description: Body qr_code = base64 of the PNG the investor downloaded (data: URI prefix allowed). 200 {import_id, status: IMPORTED, next_screen: ASSETS_DASHBOARD}. MF Central rejecting the QR → 422 with the vendor message (import stays open, last_error set); unreadable statement → FAILED invalid_payload. Allowed while AWAITING_AUTHORISATION or AWAITING_QR; idempotent once IMPORTED.
status: AWAITING_AUTHORISATION | AWAITING_QR | IMPORTED | DECLINED | FAILED (failure_category) | EXPIRED | SKIPPED, plus last_error, authorisation_url while open, expires_at and next_screen.

exec: pm.test('200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200)); console.log('import status', pm.response.json().status, pm.response.json().last_error || '');

request.description: status AVAILABLE | NOT_AVAILABLE | SKIPPED. AVAILABLE carries as_of, investor {name, pan_masked}, totals, by_asset_class, by_amc, holdings (folio_masked, nav, units, market/cost/gain), partial + notice when MF Central could not fetch every RTA, and next_screen for Continue.

exec: pm.test('200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200)); const b = pm.response.json(); console.log('portfolio', b.status, b.totals && b.totals.market_value_inr, 'holdings', (b.holdings || []).length, 'next', b.next_screen);

request.description: {status: SKIPPED, next_screen} — cancels an open import; refused (422 already_imported) once a statement is imported.

exec: pm.test('200 SKIPPED, or 422 already_imported when run after a successful import', () => pm.expect([200, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Returns EXEMPT when the KRA record already carries the IPV flag.
Start with profile_version 0. Re-saving with the old version → 409.
Indian TIN must equal the PAN. Queues TrackWizz screening + AML (worker, mock on 8099).
WireMock bank stub by account prefix: 9999… → VERIFIED (score 92); 5555… → REVIEW_REQUIRED (score 55); 1111… → ACTION_REQUIRED (invalid account).
Or {"choice":"OPT_OUT","nominees":[]}. CUSTOM allocations must sum to 100; minors need date_of_birth + guardian.
Partial answers → INCOMPLETE with missing_question_ids. LONG_TERM_GROWTH + UNDER_1_YEAR → 422 contradictory.
Only approaches permitted by the assessed band (suitability.v1.json). CONSERVATIVE_INCOME on an AGGRESSIVE profile → 422.
Scenarios: RETURN_NEGATIVE_10, RETURN_FLAT, RETURN_PLUS_10, RETURN_PLUS_20.
Masked sections + the application_version to echo back.

request.description: Renders the PDF pack (MinIO bucket pms-documents, applications/<id>/packs/) and calls the Digio eSign stub. The stub reports 'completed' on the first poll, so the worker executes within ~30 s without a webhook.
